description: A 40x40 box, gray by default, that turns teal under @media (min-height: 60px) -- which the 80px-tall viewport this fixture declares satisfies -- while a second @media (min-height: 5000px) block (declaring a red top border) never matches at that viewport. Proves min-height/max-height media queries -- unsupported by Stylo's own servo-mode media feature table -- resolve correctly against the real viewport, not just that they parse without error.

florui.css: .box { width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #808080; } @media (min-height: 60px) { .box { background-color: #2f7d6c; } } @media (min-height: 5000px) { .box { border-top-width: 6px; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: #ff0000; } }
